# Snapshot orchestrator

Load `.agents/skills/snapshot-orchestrator/SKILL.md` before any extraction. Do not reconstruct the skill from memory.

A path, filename, or photo is not a live Jira read. Group clones under parents. TSC-47959 does not replace TSC-47675.

Emit only the four artefacts named in the skill, then stop. Mark every Jira comment `DRAFT NOT POSTED`. Route VoP or FSD field work to `fa-requirement-verifier` instead of doing it here.
